summary: This Form 6-K is a routine quarterly interim financial report (Q1 2026) filed by Brookfield Infrastructure Partners L.P., a Bermuda-based foreign private issuer, under Rule 13a-16. The filing includes unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements and management’s discussion and analysis. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, activist campaign, strategic review, restructuring, or capital return is announced. The report is a standard periodic disclosure required by the Exchange Act, not a special situation filing.
